## Description

Proposed topology-aware approach to sector allocation: Compare sector-level return, trend, or risk signals and periodically adjust weights among sector funds; concentration and turnover need to be controlled. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
